input.answer: I haven't decided anything. I'll call you or go to the bank, because this page is a long black table with hundreds of numbers and I couldn't tell which track is as safe as my deposit. The only ones that looked a bit like it were "כספי (שקלי)", with 0% shares and about 4.3% a year over 3 years, and "אג"ח ממשלות", which has no numbers yet. The fees are about half a percent, and I don't know what the bank takes from me now to compare.

stuck.why: Black background with light text, and the opening goes straight to S&P and "מדד" buttons. I almost closed it. I stayed only because I came on purpose to compare kupot gemel.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: There are many buttons (מניות סחיר, עוקב מדדים - גמיש, s&p 500…) and I didn't know which one means safe. I didn't press any.

stuck.where: The column "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח" with the little circles
stuck.why: Two colours, turquoise and yellow, very close together, and I didn't know what "מט"ח" means here. I didn't try to read the circles.
The same table over and over, company after company. Too many numbers. By the fourth screen I'd had enough and stopped.

Company headings: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס
skimmed: Return column "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול": big numbers like 24.04% and 26.39%, which go with tracks full of shares
skipped: The top menu (מדריך, חוקים וכללים, השוואה למטרה…)
The search box and the "קיבוץ לפי" buttons
The link "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה"
unsure_meaning: עוקב מדדים, עוקב מדד מניות, עוקב מדדי אג"ח
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a return
Why it says "לפני דמי ניהול", and whether 4.25% is per year or for all three years
"עוד לא דווח" with a little orange mark

findings.what: Dark black background with grey-white text. Hard to read even enlarged, and the small grey words like "ההפקדה" and "שנים" almost disappear
It opens with S&P, מדדים and a long table, with nothing about saving safely or how this compares with a deposit
Hundreds of rows with many numbers each, and no sentence that sums up or recommends anything
Big returns (24%, 26%) shown before fees, right next to safe tracks. It's confusing, and it pulls my eye
Turquoise and yellow circles that look almost the same
The government bond track, the one I would trust, has no numbers at all, only "עוד לא דווח"
Long lines with the name on the right and the money on the left. I lose the line in the middle
The orange warning "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026" made me unsure whether to believe the numbers
